title.en: From Classroom to Clinic, Witnessing Real Growth

description.zh-CN: 我们的学员来自全国各大三甲医院，通过系统化的培训项目，在国际学术交流、临床观摩和职业发展等方面取得了显著成果。
description.en: Our students come from leading hospitals across China. Through systematic training programmes, they have achieved remarkable results in international academic exchange, clinical observership and career development.
